yt.title: Half of retirees claimed Social Security at 62. Now? #Shorts
yt.description:
2008: ~45% of new retirees started at 62. 2024: ~23%. At 70+: 1.5% → 9% (SSA Annual Statistical Supplement 2026).

Full video: https://youtu.be/J3rLpvQZanA

Sources: Social Security Administration — 2027 COLA Fact Sheet; Annual Statistical Supplement 2026, Table 6.B5.1; Office of the Chief Actuary, 2023 period life table (2026 Trustees Report); early retirement reduction, delayed retirement credits, survivor benefits and the retirement earnings test. Break-even ages, totals and probabilities are our calculations (today's dollars, before taxes, no investment returns).
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
Narration is AI-generated.
